# Copilot instructions

The project guide is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — read it first. It lists the
ground-truth files (`config/eyelash_corne.keymap`, `config/eyelash_corne.conf`,
`build.yaml`, `config/west.yml`), how to route through `reference-docs/`, the known
places where those docs disagree with this repo, and the rules for editing the
keymap.

Path-scoped instructions:

- `config/**` → `.github/instructions/config.instructions.md`
- `reference-docs/**` → `.github/instructions/reference-docs.instructions.md`
